description: Stops the intermittent "this beta version has expired" screen. The navigation resolver randomly (≈10% of screen changes, when in a particular licence state) hijacks navigation to the ExpiredBeta destination; this forces the guard that enables that redirect to fail, so navigation always goes to the requested screen. Nothing else (licence state, the random source) is modified. Validated on 15.0.1 (versionCode 127798).
name: Disable Symfonium beta expiry

description: Neutralises the expired-trial block screen. The welcome screen gates entry with a single `state instanceof ExpiredTrial` check; this forces that check to false, so the app proceeds on every launch (online, offline, or with a server-expired trial). The server handshake, billing/licence machinery and the offline fail-open path are left untouched. Validated on 15.0.1 (versionCode 127798).
name: Disable Symfonium trial expiry

description: Neutralises the splash 'rooted device' block by forcing the security verdict getters (o.aNj.con/Aux/AuX) to return false, so the app proceeds to the login screen. If a path to a folder is provided, the folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:

- drawable-xxxhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-hdpi
- drawable-mdpi

Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:

[Generic header]

- drawable-xxxhdpi: 488px x 192px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 366px x 144px

- drawable-hdpi: 184px x 72px
- drawable-mdpi: 122px x 48px

[Premium header]

- yt_premium_wordmark_header_light.png
- yt_premium_wordmark_header_dark.png

- drawable-xxxhdpi: 516px x 192px
